name: kar-citelock
purpose: Checks a claim against the sources it cites, with fixed rules and no AI judge: VERIFIED only when every quotation is word for word in a cited source and every content word and number is in a cited source; otherwise REFUSED, with the reason for each failed part and the offsets of every check.

lane.accepts: a claim (text) with the 1 to 50 sources it cites, as {claim, sources}
lane.refuses: anything that is not a claim with its sources: questions, requests for an opinion, and judgements of meaning or of whether a source is true

interface.out: VERIFIED or REFUSED, the reason for each failed part, and the trace: every quotation, number and content word checked, with the source and the offsets where it was found

judge.what: a claim is verified when the kernel's verify() finds every quotation word for word in a cited source and every content word and number outside the quotations in a cited source

good.claim: Revenue rose 12% in 2025, and the chair said "we will open two new sites in 2026" [report].

sources.text: Example Co. annual report, 2025. Revenue rose 12% to 4.2 million euros. The chair said: “we will open two new sites in 2026”.

bad.claim: Revenue rose 21% in 2025, and the chair said "we will open three new sites in 2026" [report].
